WITH first_tick AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, series, mid
    FROM mmsell_candidate_ticks
   WHERE captured_at >= '2026-07-19' AND captured_at < '2026-08-21'
   ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at ASC
), first_in_band AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, series, mid
    FROM mmsell_candidate_ticks
   WHERE captured_at >= '2026-07-19' AND captured_at < '2026-08-21'
     AND mid >= 5 AND mid <= 7
   ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at ASC
), ever_in_band AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker, series
    FROM mmsell_candidate_ticks
   WHERE captured_at >= '2026-07-19' AND captured_at < '2026-08-21'
     AND mid >= 5 AND mid <= 7
)
SELECT 'A first tick in band (unclass-2 construction)' AS k,
       count(*)::text AS markets,
       count(DISTINCT series)::text AS series
  FROM first_tick WHERE mid >= 5 AND mid <= 7 AND series !~ '^KX(BTC|ETH|SOL|DOGE|XRP|CRYPTO)'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'B first tick AT WHICH in band (audit construction)',
       count(*)::text, count(DISTINCT series)::text
  FROM first_in_band WHERE series !~ '^KX(BTC|ETH|SOL|DOGE|XRP|CRYPTO)'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'C ever in band (sanity: should equal B)',
       count(*)::text, count(DISTINCT series)::text
  FROM ever_in_band WHERE series !~ '^KX(BTC|ETH|SOL|DOGE|XRP|CRYPTO)'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'D in B but NOT in A (entered the band later)',
       count(*)::text, count(DISTINCT series)::text
  FROM first_in_band b WHERE series !~ '^KX(BTC|ETH|SOL|DOGE|XRP|CRYPTO)'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM first_tick a
                     WHERE a.market_ticker = b.market_ticker AND a.mid >= 5 AND a.mid <= 7)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'E all non-crypto candidate markets in the window',
       count(*)::text, count(DISTINCT series)::text
  FROM first_tick WHERE series !~ '^KX(BTC|ETH|SOL|DOGE|XRP|CRYPTO)'
